summary.intent: Redact stderr from the generic command failure message in CommandError and ship it as a second redaction PR stacked on a prior one.
summary.outcome: The generic command failure message was changed to redact stderr, a test for the failed-command message and a changeset were added, CI was run, and the change was committed, pushed and stacked as the second redaction PR. The transcript gives only tool descriptions, so CI results are not shown.

repo: CommandError has multiple constructors, and the generic command failure message is one place stderr can leak into error text.
Changes in this repo are accompanied by a changeset.
Redaction work is split into stacked PRs, with each PR covering one leak path.
CI is run locally before pushing.
workflow: Read the error type and its constructors before editing the message, and locate the existing tests first.
Stacking small, focused PRs keeps each redaction change independently reviewable.

friction: The transcript contains only brief tool descriptions with no output, so specific file paths, line numbers and CI results cannot be confirmed.
open_items: Other CommandError constructors or error paths may still include unredacted stderr and should be checked.
The stacked PR depends on the first redaction PR being merged first.
